title: Studio: wire the phone panels' actions into the iOS and Android hosts
body: Follow-up to #10570. The Rust side is on main: `VerseHandle::connect_studio(links, runtime)` in coder-mobile, `openagents_verse_studio_connect(verse, app, host, len)` in openagents-mobile (returns JSON with the rights or an error), typed text as `{"action":"studio_text","text":...}`, and Interact opening a station's panel. Wire the iOS host (bins/openagents-ios/host, thin SwiftUI) and the Android host (bins/openagents-android/host, thin Kotlin; add a JNI entry in crates/openagents-mobile/src/android.rs) to connect the studio to a paired computer, show the panels, offer Interact, and send typed text. Update docs/verse/mobile.md (it still says the OpenAgents app shows no studio panel). Acceptance: a simulator run opens the podium on a scratch host's studio and answers a decision.
